scores.notes: Left shows an unparted stormy sea at night from a rocky palm-lined shore with no dry path; right shows a daylight sandy corridor between towering water walls with red mesas beyond, so the path itself and the time of day conflict.

Daniel is an older man with short cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin in both (standing before the king on the left, standing among lions in the pit on the right); the blue-over-white robe also matches.

Left is a daylight sandy corridor between two towering water walls with red cliffs; right is an unparted stormy sea at night seen from a rocky palm-lined shore with no dry path at all, so the path and the time of day conflict.

Left Jesus is clear (dark shoulder-length hair, dark beard, blue mantle over cream tunic); on the right he is a tiny distant figure on the centre cross with head bowed, where only dark long hair can be made out and the face cannot be compared.

Both show a ridged, furrowed grass lawn enclosed by a red brick garden wall with broadleaf trees beyond, under the same overcast daylight; a tree overhangs the foreground in each, and card figures and flamingos appear on the lawn.

Jesus (standing in the boat on the left, standing on the water on the right) has the same dark shoulder-length wavy hair, short dark beard, slim build and similar age in both, plus the same blue-grey mantle over a white tunic.

Watson (seated left in the carriage; standing at the door on the right) has the same brown moustache, clean chin, squarish middle-aged face, fair skin and sturdy build in both; bowler hat and black medical bag recur.

Peter (central man with staff and net on the left; man leaping from the boat on the right) has the same curly greying dark hair, short grey-flecked beard, tanned skin and stocky build in both, with a brown mantle and net over the shoulder.

Watson (at the door on the left; standing behind Holmes on the pavement on the right) has the same thick brown moustache, clean chin, brown hair, fair skin and solid build in both, though smaller under a bowler on the right; medical bag recurs.

Left Holmes (striking with the cane) has a full head of dark slicked-back hair over a gaunt face; right Holmes (at the door, far right) is markedly bald on top with only side hair and a rounder, softer skull, a clear hair/hairline conflict.

The table under a big tree on grass matches, but the house behind conflicts: left is a thatched half-timbered cottage with rose-covered doorway, right is a pale weatherboard house with a columned porch and no thatch.

Watson (in bowler with bag on the left; arms folded by the fire on the right) is a fair-skinned, sturdy man with a full brown moustache and clean chin in both; the right face is a little more lined and the moustache slightly more auburn, but no clear identity cue conflicts.

Taking left Watson as the man Holmes pulls in by the arm (brown suit, light-brown hair, brown moustache, clean chin), he matches the seated right Watson (brown suit, brown hair and moustache, similar age and build). Note the left image also has a second Watson-like man in a bowler with a medical bag; he too is moustached and brown-haired, so neither reading conflicts.

David (slinger on the left; boy dodging the spear on the right) is a beardless teenage youth with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in both, wearing a short brown tunic; the left figure is small but the cues agree.

David (with sling on the left; ducking the spear with a harp on the right) is the same beardless teenage youth with short curly hair, tan skin and lean build; hair reads slightly browner on the left and darker on the right, but face shape and age match, as do tunic and shoulder bag.

Holmes (stooping with the stick on the left; seated with pipe and photograph on the right) has the same gaunt clean-shaven hawk-nosed face, dark slicked-back hair with high forehead, pale skin and thin build in both.

Both show the same kind of open single-masted plank fishing boat on a grey-green lake with a steep green-brown hilly shore at right and distant ridges under storm cloud; the right has a torn sail and the left shows no sail in frame, but hull, water and shoreline are compatible and the storm/calm change is asked for.

Alice (giant in the courtroom on the left; seated in the armchair on the right) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown/strawberry-blonde hair, fair skin and similar face in both, wearing the same yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Moses (striking the rock with raised rod on the left; seated on the stone between two men on the right) is the same old man with long white swept-back hair, full white beard, weathered tan skin, in a cream tunic and brown mantle in both.
Watson (seated right in the carriage; standing with folded arms by the fire) has the same brown hair, thick reddish-brown moustache, clean chin, ruddy middle-aged face and solid build in both.

Alice (holding the flamingo on the left; standing in the courtroom aisle on the right) is the same young girl with long light-brown/dark-blonde hair, fair skin and round face in both, in the same yellow dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.
Watson (seated on the bed on the left; at the door with hat and bag on the right) has the same brown side-parted hair, thick brown moustache, clean chin, fair skin and sturdy build in both.

Moses (seen in back-three-quarter profile on the shore on the left; seated with arms held up on the right) is an old man with white windswept hair and a long white beard in both, with matching cream tunic and brown mantle; the left face is partly turned away but hair, beard and age agree.

Both show a wet sandy seabed corridor receding between two towering teal water walls under a dark storm-cloud sky (night/moonlit in both); the right shows more rocky hills at the far end but the corridor, walls and lighting are compatible.

Peter (the man clasping the beggar's hand on the left; large foreground figure on the right) has the same short curly dark hair greying at the sides, short grey-flecked beard, tanned skin and stocky build in both, with a rough brown mantle. (The net is carried by the companion on the left, but that is an accessory.)

Alice (seated at the table end on the left; small standing figure in profile before the mushroom on the right) has the same long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, child's build and age in both, with the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; the right face is small and in profile but nothing conflicts.

Alice (small profile figure by the mushroom on the left; standing in the court aisle on the right) has the same long straight light-brown/dark-blonde hair, fair skin and young child's build in both, with yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; the left face is small and in profile but nothing conflicts.

David (with sling at left; boy being anointed with bowed head at right) is a beardless teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slight build in both, in the same ragged brown tunic with shoulder bag; the right face is bowed but hair, age and build agree.

Both Daniels are grey-bearded men in the same blue fringed robe, but the left (being hauled from the pit) has close-cropped grey hair, a rounder older face and darker tan skin, while the right (foreground) has full wavy collar-length grey hair swept back, a longer narrower and younger-looking face and paler skin; hair length/style and face shape conflict.

Left Daniel (foreground) has full wavy collar-length grey hair swept back, a long narrow face and paler skin; right Daniel (small, in the pit among lions) has close-cropped/receding grey hair, a rounder older face and darker skin. Both have short grey beards and the same blue robe, but hair length/style and face conflict.

Both show an open single-masted wooden plank fishing boat with rope rigging on a choppy grey-blue lake ringed by low dark hills under storm cloud; the right shows a torn sail and heavier seas, the left no sail in frame, but hull, lake and hills are compatible and the storm-to-calm change is asked for.

Moses (raising the rod by the rock on the left; arm outstretched over the sea on the right) is the same old man with white hair, full white beard, tan weathered skin and similar build, in cream tunic and brown mantle in both.

David (dodging the spear on the left; kneeling to be anointed on the right) is a beardless teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in both, in a rough brown tunic; the right head is bowed so the face is partly hidden, but hair, age and build agree.

Both show the same open wooden fishing boat with a single mast, tattered pale sail and a lit lantern hung at the mast, on a dark lake with hilly shores under heavy cloud in dim light; the right is calmer, a bit brighter (twilight glow vs moonlit night) and shows the shore villages closer, which fits a different viewpoint and the asked-for calm.

Both show a long wooden tea table on grass under a large spreading tree with a pale weatherboard house with a posted porch just behind, in daylight; the right adds a tablecloth and an armchair for Alice, but tree, lawn and house style and arrangement are compatible.

Both show a long white-clothed tea table on a lawn under one big broad-trunked tree with an old English gabled, timber-framed house to the left behind, in soft daylight; the house is farther off and browner on the left and close with brick and bay windows on the right, but style and arrangement are compatible with a shifted viewpoint.

Both show a white-clothed tea table on a lawn beneath one big broad-trunked tree with a brick and half-timbered, leaded-window English house to the left behind, in soft daylight; the house sits closer and larger on the left and set back on the right, but its Tudor style and the arrangement are compatible.

Peter (stepping from the boat on the left; clasping the beggar's hand on the right) has the same short curly dark hair greying at the temples, short grey-flecked beard, tanned skin and stocky build in both, in a rough brown mantle over a cream tunic.

Both show a calm, mist-hung lake at early-morning light with hazy rolling hills and a low earthy shore, the same wooden boat and nets; the left sees the shore from the water at a distance and the right stands on it (with a village and palms further along), which are compatible viewpoints.

Both show a small open wooden fishing boat with a single mast swamped by steep dark waves at night, with the moon breaking through storm cloud in the same position; the left includes a hilly village shore and other boats that the tighter right view omits, and the sail is furled left and set right, but the place and occasion are compatible.

Both cats are striped tabbies with a huge toothy grin, but the left cat (on the branch) has a cool grey coat while the right cat (floating head) is a warm ginger/orange-brown tabby with a broader face; coat colour is a clear conflict.

Jesus (standing on the water on the left; calling toward the tomb on the right) has the same dark shoulder-length wavy hair, short dark beard, slim build, similar age and skin tone in both, with blue-grey mantle over a white tunic.

Watson (at the door with hat and bag on the left; seated in a bowler in the carriage on the right) has the same thick brown moustache, clean chin, brown hair, fair ruddy skin, squarish face and sturdy build in both.

Watson (on the bed shading his eyes on the left; seated at right in the carriage) has the same brown hair, thick brown moustache, clean chin, fair skin and medium-sturdy build in both; the left figure is smaller with a hand at his brow but hair and moustache are clear.

Left Alice is clear (wavy light-brown hair, round child's face). On the right she is a small figure turned away toward the bench, showing mostly the back of her head and only a sliver of profile, so the face cannot be compared; long light-brown hair, child's build and the yellow dress/pinafore are consistent but not enough to judge identity.

Alice (holding up the bottle on the left; standing beside the mushroom on the right) is the same young girl with wavy light-brown shoulder-length hair, round fair face, similar age and small build in both, in the yellow dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Moses (raising the rod by the rock on the left; smaller figure with crook at right of the crowd on the right) is an old man with white hair and a full white beard in both, with cream tunic and dark brown mantle; the right figure is small and dimly lit but hair, beard, age and build agree.

Daniel (watching the fiery throne on the left; addressing the king on the right) is the same older man with close-cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tan skin and lean build in both, in a blue fringed robe over cream with a scroll case.

Alice (seated in the armchair on the left; running with the flamingo on the right) is the same young girl with long wavy light-brown hair, fair rosy round face, similar age and build in both, in yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; hair reads slightly more golden left and more chestnut right, a lighting-level difference only.

Daniel (looking up at the vision on the left; pointing at the wall on the right) is an older lean man with short cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin in both, with a blue fringed mantle over cream; hair and beard read a little whiter on the smaller left figure and more salt-and-pepper on the right, but length, style, age and face agree.

Peter (leaping from the boat on the left; holding the beggar's hand on the right) has the same short curly dark hair greying at the sides, short greying beard, tanned skin and stocky build in both, in a rough brown mantle.

Left Holmes (foreground with pipe and lens) is a gaunt, lined middle-aged man with straight dark slicked-back hair and a high receding forehead; right Holmes (pulling the man in at the door) is a visibly younger smooth-faced man with a thick tousled mop of dark curly hair over his forehead. Hair style, hairline and age conflict.

Moses (large foreground figure with staff on the left; the staff-bearing man at the centre-front of the crowd on the right) is an old man with white swept-back hair, full white beard and tan skin in both, in cream tunic and brown mantle. The right figure is small and a near-identical white-bearded man walks beside him, but the one with the staff matches.

Alice (standing in the court on the left; seated in the armchair on the right) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair round face, similar age and build in both, in yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both show a grey-lit lake under heavy overcast with dark hills around it and a stony, pebbled shore where a small fire burns; the left sees that shore from the water at a distance, the right stands on it (adding a village on the far bank), with the same boat and nets. Light, water and shore type are compatible.

Both show a small open wooden boat with a single bare mast and a lit lantern on a black, heaving lake at night, with the moon behind storm cloud at upper left and a low dark hilly shore on the horizon; viewpoint differs (close on deck vs side-on) but boat, water, sky and time match.

Alice (drinking from the bottle on the left; standing before the mushroom on the right) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown/strawberry-blonde hair, fair round face, similar age and build in both, in yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; the left face is partly covered by the bottle but profile and hair agree.

Peter (raising the beggar on the left; wading ashore in a pale tunic on the right) has the same short curly greying hair, short grey beard, tanned skin, similar age and stocky build in both; hair reads a little greyer on the right and the brown mantle is absent there, but no identity cue conflicts.

The right shows the house itself (white two-storey house with chimneys ablaze, lawn, hedges, lane, fire engines) at night in flat farmland. The left is set at the railway station and shows the fire only as a distant glow and smoke column over flat hedged fields at night; nothing conflicts, but the house and its grounds are not visible there, so the place cannot really be compared.
